programme.title: Iron Kid
programme.desc: Gaff, Guardián de la Familia Eon y protector del Puño, está huyendo de la asesina a sueldo Belleza Negra y su equipo de Ninjas Robots. Escapa por poco de su ataque y arroja una caja de madera en una cueva de la Zona Prohibida, un área controlada por el Duque von Rhymer, presidente de la Torre de Hierro. La caja contiene el Puño de Eón.

programme.title: Domi Kids
programme.desc: "Domi Kids es una serie musical animada en 3D que da vida a las alegres y cálidas aventuras diarias de la familia Domi, compuesta por cinco integrantes. Con música animada y divertida, y actuaciones de múltiples personajes, el programa ofrece una gran variedad de temas, historias atractivas y escenas diversas. Un equipo profesional de producción musical asegura melodías de primera calidad, arreglos excepcionales y actuaciones vocales destacadas, brindando un festín audiovisual encantador para los niños. El contenido es positivo, entretenido y está diseñado para ayudar a los niños a aprender y explorar el mundo de una manera apropiada para su edad. Además, apoya a los padres en su camino hacia una crianza fácil y placentera, mientras acompaña a los niños en su crecimiento y desarrollo."

programme.title: BarryTiger
programme.desc: BarryTiger es una serie animada en 3D vibrante y cautivadora, diseñada para niños de 1 a 8 años, que da vida a aventuras cotidianas a través de música pegajosa y encantadora. Con una variedad de personajes coloridos y temas ricos y diversos, la serie muestra los momentos alegres de la vida de la familia BarryTiger. La producción musical de alta calidad, con melodías excepcionales, arreglos sobresalientes y actuaciones destacadas, añade una capa extra de diversión a las escenas animadas y dinámicas. ¡Prepárate para cantar, bailar y explorar junto a Barry y sus amigos en cada emocionante episodio!

programme.title: Maderitas
programme.desc: Maderitas – es una serie de películas animadas para niños en edad preescolar.Los protagonistas son juguetes de madera: la Gatita Miau, el Perrito Guau Guau, el Cerdito Oink, el Caballito Ico Co y el Elefantito Du Du. Estos juguetes viven en una pequeña ciudad de madera (prototipo de una habitación de juego para niños). Cada juguete tiene su carácter y reacciona a su manera a los sucesos que ocurren. Guiados por la voz de un narrador invisible los juguetes junto con los espectadores superan diferentes obstáculos, juegan y viven sus aventuras. “Maderitas” es una serie musical con muchos bailes y canciones. Algunas de esas canciones representan a nuestros protagonistas y se escuchan en cada episodio. Otras canciones están relacionadas con los hechos que ocurren en el episodio, y por eso solo se escuchan en determinados capítulos. En los episodios hay elementos educativos en forma de juego. Los juguetes junto con los espectadores van conociendo los colores, las formas, objetos, encuentran solución a situaciones difíciles, aprenden a ser verdaderos amigos, a ayudarse los unos a los otros, exploran el mundo. Los episodios son positivos, humanos y con buen sentido de humor.

programme.title: BFF
programme.desc: Las BFF son un grupo de amigas adolescentes que descubren que juntas pueden superar cualquier situación por complicada que sea y convertirse en… ¡mejores amigas para siempre! Sus aventuras están llenas de momentos musicales y situaciones desternillantes interrumpidas constantemente por Shadow, un personaje mágico y travieso que intenta difundir desesperadamente negatividad y “malas vibraciones”. Sin embargo, ¡sus intentos se verán frustrados por las BFF y sus collares de la amistad!

programme.title: El Mundo de Luna
programme.desc: Curiosa por todo y entusiasmada por la ciencia, Luna, de 6 años, y su hermano Júpiter y su mascota Clyde exploran la naturaleza para conocer el mundo.

programme.desc: Tus personajes preferidos de El Reino Infantil te esperan, en este nuevo episodio, para cantar y bailar con las canciones y los videos más divertidos!

programme.title: La linterna mágica
programme.desc: La serie animada «La linterna mágica» se encargará de contarles a los más pequeñitos maravillosas historias de aventuras basadas en clásicos literarios. Cada historia se presenta en una película de filminas que mira y discute un joven amante de los videojuegos llamado Mike y una sabelotodo llamada Kate. Los simpáticos personajes nos permitirán ver historias clásicas desde un ángulo diferente y nos demostrarán que los clásicos pueden ser divertidos e interesantes.

programme.title: Bjorn y Bucky
programme.desc: "Bjorn y Bucky tienen que ver con la amistad y la capacidad de vivir bien con la tecnología en nuestro mundo natural moderno. ¡Bucky es un oso Pardo de alta energía que ama los gadgets, la tecnología y el Werkzeuge! El oso polar Bjorn es un niño de la naturaleza que ama relajarse, meditar e incluso aquí y allá. El amigo de los osos Jr., Franny Fox, juega un papel importante, y en algunos episodios puede tener un número significativo de pistas. Las historias tienden a contar sobre el conflicto creado por un enfoque demasiado técnico de la situación y la búsqueda de una solución en la naturaleza, o viceversa. La serie es positiva, cómica y optimista. Estos temas tienen como objetivo ayudar a las personas a ver que es posible vivir en armonía con la naturaleza mientras viven una vida moderna rica, llena de ciencia y tecnología."

programme.title: Planeta de Niños
programme.desc: Divertida y cautivadora serie educativa y de entretenimiento para niños, que refuerza virtudes fundamentales y modales enseñados a los niños por sus padres y maestros, en la escuela y en casa. Desde la confianza, humildad y el perdón, a la honestidad, responsabilidad, cooperación y dignidad. El show ayuda a los niños a comprender la importancia desde pequeños detalles como ser corteses, hasta a desarrollar grandes virtudes y habilidades, como saber toma de decisiones.

programme.title: Papelitos
programme.desc: La serie animada “papelitos” cuenta de una manera divertida a los más pequeñitos sobre las simpáticas aventuras de unos animales de papel: Un alce llamado Aristóteles y un pájaro carpintero llamado Tuc-Tuc en el país de papel donde todo por completo está hecho de papel. Divertidas aventuras se acompañan con interesantes clases de manualidades donde los espectadores aprenderán como con papel y cartón crear a todos los personajes de la serie utilizando tijeras y pegamento. El proyecto tiene apoyo de la página web donde están presentados todos los moldes y consejos para crear el mundo de papel. De esta manera el espectador participa en el juego que supone la creación y el desarrollo de muchas habilidades prácticas que distraen a los chicos del encierro permanente de la computadora. El proyecto “Papelitos” es una divertida y didáctica alternativa en lugar de pasar tiempo con la computadora. Toda la acción en el dibujo animado es narrada por una voz en off y repleta de ingeniosos chistes. Cada capítulo dura 5 minutos (la versión sin clase – 4 minutos). La técnica de animación – gráficos 3D que imitan al papel.

Estos juguetes viven en una pequeña ciudad de madera (prototipo de una habitación de juego para niños). Cada juguete tiene su carácter y reacciona a su manera a los sucesos que ocurren. Guiados por la voz de un narrador invisible los juguetes junto con los espectadores superan diferentes obstáculos, juegan y viven sus aventuras. “Maderitas” es una serie musical con muchos bailes y canciones. Algunas de esas canciones representan a nuestros protagonistas y se escuchan en cada episodio. Otras canciones están relacionadas con los hechos que ocurren en el episodio, y por eso solo se escuchan en determinados capítulos. En los episodios hay elementos educativos en forma de juego. Los juguetes junto con los espectadores van conociendo los colores, las formas, objetos, encuentran solución a situaciones difíciles, aprenden a ser verdaderos amigos, a ayudarse los unos a los otros, exploran el mundo. Los episodios son positivos, humanos y con buen sentido de humor.

programme.title: Iron Kid
programme.desc: Gaff, Guardián de la Familia Eon y protector del Puño, está huyendo de la asesina a sueldo Belleza Negra y su equipo de Ninjas Robots. Escapa por poco de su ataque y arroja una caja de madera en una cueva de la Zona Prohibida, un área controlada por el Duque von Rhymer, presidente de la Torre de Hierro. La caja contiene el Puño de Eón.

programme.title: Evolution of Violence
programme.desc: Guatemala. La guerra terminó hace mucho tiempo. Aunque la gente quiere olvidarlo, la violencia continúa. Cada día, los periodistas informan sobre el próximo asesinato y los trabajadores sociales ayudan a los familiares de los asesinados. La sociedad sufre las consecuencias de los 36 años de guerra civil. Se encuentran fosas comunes en las montañas, ex rebeldes lloran a sus camaradas y un criminal de guerra tiene pesadillas sobre las cosas que ha hecho.

programme.title: Cómo Identificar un Culto
programme.desc: Los observadores de sectas afirman que las sectas están en aumento. Y hay ciertas características que los expertos dicen que tienen en común. Aunque las organizaciones en este documental pueden o no ser sectas, ex miembros dicen que han utilizado técnicas como el bombardeo de amor, el asesinato de carácter, el miedo y la culpa. Aseguran que fueron manipulados por líderes carismáticos que prometían el único camino verdadero.

programme.title: Cómo Identificar un Culto
programme.desc: En el interior, los creyentes piensan que por muy mal que sea la vida, escapar sería peor; los expertos en sectas nos dicen que esta creencia es una consecuencia del control mental. Escucha a ex miembros de organizaciones similares a sectas y cómo lograron liberarse a sí mismos y a sus mentes.

programme.title: Episodio 01
programme.desc: Fue solo después de su muerte que Eva Braun saltó a la fama en Alemania. Junto con Adolf Hitler, el 30 de abril de 1945 se quitó la vida en el búnker bajo la Cancillería del Reich en Berlín. El día anterior, el dictador se había casado con Braun, su amante durante muchos años. Apartada del mundo, Eva Braun pasó la mayor parte del tiempo en Múnich o en la residencia Berghof de Hitler en los Alpes. Después de la guerra, Albert Speer, antiguo arquitecto de Adolf Hitler, describió a Braun como una de las "decepciones de la historia". La primera biografía científica de Heike Görtmaker busca revisar la imagen de la rubia y apolítica figura al lado del Führer.

programme.title: Episodio 01 – El Dictador
programme.desc: Las imágenes del Tercer Reich en la memoria de generaciones siempre se conservan en blanco y negro. Pero ocultas en archivos fílmicos y colecciones privadas, también se han conservado imágenes completamente diferentes, en color. Tomadas en las playas de Normandía y en sencillos festivales folclóricos, documentan las atrocidades de la Wehrmacht durante la guerra y la vida en la granja de montaña de Hitler, y aportan una realidad opresiva a las imágenes del criminal régimen nazi.

programme.title: Heroes of Envell
programme.desc: Present days. Saint Petersburg. Four friends – Art, Kira, Phil and Vic are the coolest gamers in school. Eventually they find a suspicious laptop with «Heroes of Envell» game installed on it. Turns out that this very laptop is a portal to another dimension, a game realm which is full of adventures and real-life danger. The game realm is a blend of medieval, steampunk and futurism. You never know what really awaits our heroes. Just like the design of the game, the game logic is very unpredictable. You start with a quest and then it becomes a race right until it all grows into a tricky brainteaser. But be sure about one thing – there is no boring or easy way in here. programme.title: Woodventures
programme.desc: "Woodventures" is an animated series for preschool children. The main characters are wooden toys: Kitty Meow, Doggy Woof-Woof, Piggy Oink, Horsey Yee-Ho-Ho and Elephant Pawoo. The toys live in a small wooden town (the prototype of a child's play room). Every toy has its own unique personality and reacts to different circumstances appropriately. With the help of the invisible narrator, the toys, along with the audience solve different tasks, play and take part in adventures. "Woodventures" is a musical series with lots of songs and dances. Some of the songs represent our characters and appear in each series, and some of the songs are related to the events in the series, so it is only found in that particular episode.Each episode presents a playful and learning environment. Toys, along with the audience, learn about colors, shapes, objects, come out of difficult situations, learn about friendship and the world in general. The series is simple, kind and funny.

programme.title: Paper Tales
programme.desc: Animation series “Paper Tales” narrate to children audience in fascinating way amusing adventures of paper animals – a moose named Aristotle and a woodpecker named Knock-Knock – in paper land where everything is made only from paper. Merry adventures come together with entertaining insets “for crafty hands” when the audience learns how to produce all cartoon characters using paper, cardboard, scissors and glue. The project is supported with the site where all flat patterns are provided with the advices how to manufacture the paper world items.This is the way spectator gets involved into a peculiar game that brings out creative work and development of many useful practical skills, distracting kids from permanent attachment to a computer. The “Paper Tales” project is a fascinating and helpful alternative to computer-oriented pastime. The whole cartoon is accompanied by off-screen narrator’s text and exuberant flow of gags. Each episode is planned to last for 5 minutes (a version without insets – 4 minutes). Technique of performance is 3D computer graphics imitating paper application work.

programme.title: El Guardaespaldas
programme.desc: «El guardaespaldas» es una mezcla de película de Kung Fu llena de acción y superhéroes. Wu-Lin, el protagonista, eligió el camino oscuro para buscar venganza y tomarse la justicia por su mano. Wu-Lin no es sólo un hombre normal del pueblo rural, también es el sucesor de un antiguo y antaño poderoso clan chino, los «Pies de Hierro». Tras la muerte del maestro del clan, Wu-Lin abandonó la aldea y llegó a la Ciudad de Piedra Fría en busca de su compañero aprendiz Jiang Li. Resulta ser el guardaespaldas de Fei-Fei, la hija de Jia-Shan Li, la familia más rica de la ciudad. El choque de una niña rica y revoltosa con un guardaespaldas rudo y masculino, enciende la llama del amor verdadero. Wu-Lin pronto descubre que un grupo de mafiosos liderado por Jiang Li, intenta secuestrar a Fei-Fei. Para proteger a su amada, Wu-Lin se ve obligado a luchar solo contra ellos. Brutalmente aplastado, pero Wu-Lin consiguió sobrevivir, se quitó los zapatos de hierro y volvió a sentir la adrenalina en su cuerpo. Wu-Lin decidió enfrentarse al grupo de mafiosos una vez más, y sabe que alguien mucho más grande y fuerte que Jiang Li está detrás del malvado complot.

2 Nations, 1 Obsession - Episode 1
programme.desc: In terms of rivalries in world sport, there is arguably none as fierce as that between the Australia and Indian cricket. - - This documentary explores the stories behind the remarkable 1986 Tied Test in Madras, the gripping final over bowled by Greg Matthews plus the remarkable feat that was Dean Jones’ double hundred. - - Fast-forward 15 years and the 2001 series between the nations is widely regarded as one of the best series ever played. In particular, the dramatic Third Test where a plucky young off spinner named Harbhajan Singh ripped through Australia to take 15 wickets for the match, and lead India to victory. - - 2 Nations 1 Obsession isn’t just an epic Cricket story – it’s a tale of how two countries with such different DNA - can be brought together for the love of a game. - - Allan Border, Sunil Gavaskar, Greg Matthews, Adam Gilchrist, Ravi Shastri and Stuart Clark are just a few of the cricket legends who feature prominently in this film.

programme.title: Complexx: The Two Exes

programme.title: The Games We Play

programme.title: All the Love
programme.desc: A young woman begins her journey to adulthood, navigating love and self-discovery, while being haunted by a mysterious past that she can’t fully remember. As murders and violence swirl around her, she wonders who she can trust. Will she find love or suffer the same mysterious fate as her birth parents?

programme.title: Double Standards

programme.title: Dirty Cops LA
programme.desc: Ex-hustler turned cop, Detective Jackson and his Partner Detective Johnson, an ex-gang member turned shady do-gooder, bring a new meaning to the phrase "boys-in-blue". Normally pre-occupied with robbing and assaulting the city's criminal element, they also make time to close a few cases along the way. The city has been taken over by an outsider known as "El Jefe", a Mexican drug lord that has decided to make LA his new home. Jackson and Johnson plan on helping him get "settled in".

programme.title: Fist of Vengeance
programme.desc: Ciara Johnson is struggling with life after the death of her father in a local martial arts gym. To preserve her father’s legacy, Ciara is determined to win the regional Wushu Regional championship, and to keep the art alive in her father’s memory. However, she discovers a secret operation that is connected to her father’s death. Witness the showdown between legacy, and the new school of martial arts.

programme.title: Campaign of Deception
programme.desc: Arie Hinkley has it all - A beautiful family, a husband who is about to be mayor, money, friends, the perfect life. Until a stranger from her past returns to reveal a mysterious and disturbing past from Arie that not only threatens her husband Booker Hinkley's campaign but may very well ruin Arie's dream life.

programme.title: Complex
programme.desc: The disappearance of a beautiful woman and the murder of another, leads to the investigation of four different families, living inside of one apartment complex.

programme.title: Designer
programme.desc: Dre has aspirations of making it big in the cannabis industry, but when his perceived star plant dies, his hopes and dreams start to fade. He finds himself and his 2 buddies embark on a wild adventure with their sights set on the components to make the strain of all strains of cannabis.

programme.title: Boxed In
programme.desc: Ria is an up and coming female boxer whose one and only focus is to be the best boxer alive. That's until she meets Tuga, who shows her that a life without love really isn't a life at all.

programme.title: Bloodguilt
programme.desc: David and best friend Uriah run a marketing firm together. When he meets Uriah’s wife Bathsheba, he begins a dangerous affair that could unravel everything the two friends have built.

programme.title: The House on Adams Drive
programme.desc: Sean is convinced the only way to keep the woman of his dreams happy is by obtaining as much money as possible. His friend Kordell, who’s an adult film star, helps him with a way to make a lot of money overnight. When they’re sent to a house to possibly film a scene, that turns out to be a real life exorcism.

programme.title: Her Other Man

programme.title: When broken Porsches staggered to Le Mans victory
programme.desc: With 9 Porsche 956s finishing in the top 10, the 1983 24 Hours of Le Mans was a truly remarkable feat for Porsche. But just exactly how did they win? programme.title: F1's Ugliest Cars
programme.desc: As we saw in our previous video, there have been some stunning F1 cars throughout the years. And on the other side of the coin, some we'd really rather not have to look at again. An ugly car doesn't necessarily mean a bad car though, as each of the cars in this list did manage to get at least one win under it's respective, unattractive belt. From hideous raised noses to unsightly intakes to just plain ugly chassis, we take a look back through Formula 1's 70 years to find out which cars are the most offensive to the human eye, that still managed to get at least one win in its lifetime.

programme.title: Roaring To Victory - Jaguar
programme.desc: After an absence of almost three decades, Jaguar returned to top flight sportscar racing in 1985. This is the action-packed story of how the legendary British marque roared back to victory. Archive race footage traces the full story of how Tom Walkinshaw Racing took Jaguar to the top, claiming World Championship success and securing Jaguar's first victory at the Le Mans 24 Hours for 31 years. This film features highlights from the road to victory, from the debut of the XJR-6 at Canada's Mosport in August 1985 through to the 1988 Le Mans triumph of the XJR-9LM. You'll see the Tony Southgate-designed Jaguars in action at iconic circuits like Spa, Silverstone, Monza, Fuji and, of course, the Circuit de la Sarthe, from 1985, '86, '87 and '88. There's fabulous race highlights, including in-car footage, featuring Jaguar racing greats including Derek Warwick, Eddie Cheever, Martin Brundle, Jan Lammers, Raul Boesel, John Watson, Johnny Dumfries, Andy Wallace, Jean-Louis Schlesser and more. There's interviews with many of these stars, plus contributions from Tom Walkinshaw and Jaguar chairman Sir John Egan. Roaring to Victory is the comprehensive story of three incredible years.

programme.title: Why F1's Madrid 2026 Circuit NEEDS to Avoid Valencia's Failures
programme.desc: F1 has announced that from 2026, the Spanish GP will be held at a brand-new hybrid street circuit in Madrid for 10 years. But having seen Formula 1 previously try to migrate the Spanish GP circuit to Valencia in 2013, which ended up failing entirely, is Madrid's Spanish GP set to fail as well? programme.title: Roaring To Victory - Jaguar
programme.desc: After an absence of almost three decades, Jaguar returned to top flight sportscar racing in 1985. This is the action-packed story of how the legendary British marque roared back to victory. Archive race footage traces the full story of how Tom Walkinshaw Racing took Jaguar to the top, claiming World Championship success and securing Jaguar's first victory at the Le Mans 24 Hours for 31 years. This film features highlights from the road to victory, from the debut of the XJR-6 at Canada's Mosport in August 1985 through to the 1988 Le Mans triumph of the XJR-9LM. You'll see the Tony Southgate-designed Jaguars in action at iconic circuits like Spa, Silverstone, Monza, Fuji and, of course, the Circuit de la Sarthe, from 1985, '86, '87 and '88. There's fabulous race highlights, including in-car footage, featuring Jaguar racing greats including Derek Warwick, Eddie Cheever, Martin Brundle, Jan Lammers, Raul Boesel, John Watson, Johnny Dumfries, Andy Wallace, Jean-Louis Schlesser and more. There's interviews with many of these stars, plus contributions from Tom Walkinshaw and Jaguar chairman Sir John Egan. Roaring to Victory is the comprehensive story of three incredible years.

programme.title: The Funny Files
programme.desc: Join Jamie Kaler as he breaks down the top 10 most absurd, unexpected, and hilarious clips of the day.

programme.title: Beyonce: Queen B
programme.desc: One of the most recognizable figures in contemporary music. Get lost in the ultimate story of modern day superstardom as we take you through the incredible journey of Beyoncé. Directed by Billy Simpson.

programme.title: Britney Spears: Unbreakable
programme.desc: Look into the glamorous and tumultuous life of pop sensation Britney Spears. From her incredible skyrocketing ascent into stardom to her personal troubles and downfalls, see the inside of the star's life with exclusive interviews. Directed by Sonia Anderson.

programme.title: Chris Rock: One Man Show
programme.desc: This hilarious, unapologetic, hard-working comic with sharp social punchlines hasnâ€™t always had it easy. In fact he draws his comedy from a darker side of his past. We look back at the life and rise of the one who was once named the funniest man in America. Directed by Roxane Schlumberger

programme.title: Killed Walking Home
programme.desc: Every three days, a woman is killed in the UK. These women could be sisters, daughters, and friends. Although there is a lead that breaks open the case - what comes in light of the investigation is one that leaves an everlasting scar on the families.Directed by Afsheen Hussein, Jordan Hill, and Brian Aabech.

programme.title: Bruce Willis: All American Hero
programme.desc: Bruce Willis is one of the all-time greats. For the Hollywood action hero with an incredible body of workout was his portrayal of police officer John McClane in Die Hard that catapulted Bruce Willis to stardom. The action-packed flick hit movie screens across the country with a bang, later spawned four sequels, and established him as one of Hollywood's leading action hero. Bruce Willis has remained one of the most well-known actors of his generation. Known for his charm and humor, through career highs and lows Willis enjoyed much fame. With over a hundred films to his credit and many successful ones to boot, Bruce Willis is certainly an actor who has amassed a widespread fan following throughout his career. Willis showed no signs of slowing down, until a tragic announcement in 2022. Directed by Roxane Schlumberger.

programme.title: Barbie's Pink World
programme.desc: She is plastic, she is fantastic. She's Barbie of course. But she is way more than just plastic, she is way more than a toy. The pretty blond has become a worldwide sensation especially after the blockbuster movie starring Margot Robbie and directed by Greta Gerwig. Barbie's been around for so long, but hasn't aged a day. She's had more than 200 different jobs; she's been president, she's been to the moon, and she's done all the things that women want to do. She has a massive closet, and thousands of stylish outfits. Barbie has inspired dreams, wonder and imagination, and, can you guess her favourite color? Welcome to Barbie's Pink World. Directed by Roxane Schlumberger.

programme.title: Oppenheimer: The Real Story
programme.desc: In 1945, the world was ushered into the atomic age. With his role as the Father of the Bomb solidified, Oppenheimer became increasingly worried about the potential danger that scientific inventions could pose to humanity. Directed by Poorabi Gaekwad.

programme.title: Scarface: The Al Capone Story
programme.desc: Al Capone - aka Scarface - is the most infamous gangster of all time. In the Roaring Twenties, Al Capone ruled an empire of crime in the Windy City: gambling, prostitution, bootlegging, bribery, narcotics trafficking, robbery, "protection" rackets, and murder. And it seemed that law enforcement couldn't touch him. That was until one fatal night in 1929. Directed by Finlay Bald.

programme.title: Hitler's Last Days
programme.desc: Germany is in decline. Once the world's most powerful country is now being devastated by WW2. Adolf Hitler has gone into hiding. The dreaded ruler is no longer openly supporting his people. He is slowly losing his mind. This documentary gives insight into the last days of Hitler’s life as well as his death. With expert contributors like Guy Walters and Dr. Lisa Pine, this project uncovers an intriguing perspective on history. Directed by Daria Tuca.

programme.title: Princess Diana: Unexpected Icon
programme.desc: Diana Spencer was that quiet shy girl who every young lady could relate to. The difference with her is that she became a princess. From then on she shot up into stardom to become one of the biggest icons, not only in the UK, but in the entire world. Directed by Nick Randall.

programme.title: The Barbie Story
programme.desc: Barbie is way more than just a 12-inches long piece of plastic, she is way more than a toy. The legendary blond bombshell has grown into a phenomenon and a children's sensation. Wildly revolutionary, Barbie broke barriers, shattered glass ceilings, and has inspired countless dreams, wonder and imagination. The history of the doll is a testament to its enduring appeal and impact. Things have changed for her the same way things changed for women. Whatever we may think about Barbie - love or loathe her - it is impossible to ignore her worldwide impact. Let's step into the beautiful world of Barbie and take a look at her cultural revolution through the decades. Directed by Roxane Schlumberger.

programme.title: Murderous Minds: Dennis Nilsen
programme.desc: Dennis Andrew Nilsen was a Scottish serial killer and necrophile who murdered at least twelve young men and boys between 1978 and 1983 in - London. Directed by Remone Jones.

programme.title: Adele: Homecoming
programme.desc: Adele is a Grammy Award-winning artist whose soulful sound has thrust her into the limelight. Her soulful voice, frank personality and chart-topping hits have made her one of the most successful artists of all time. Her authenticity in her work appeals to so many; there are no gimmicks with Adele. What you see is what you get. Through her own words, video and live performances, this documentary takes an incredible look at the life and times of one of the greatest artists of all time. Directed by Billy Simpson.

programme.title: Andy Warhol: A Life In Art
programme.desc: From early on in his career, Andy Warhol had an extraordinary ability to find the sacred in the profane. Like so many successful Americans, he was a product of Eastern European immigrant experience, who himself became an icon - a shy, gay, working-class man who became the court painter of the 1960s and 70s, who became one of the most glamorous figure of 20th Century American Art. Directed by Finlay Bald.

programme.title: Banksy: Street Rat
programme.desc: Banksy changed the modern art world, taking it from galleries and onto the street. His identity has always been hidden from the public; keeping this secret was key to avoiding any criminal charges. He made headlines for his Kissing Coppers, painted the West Bank Wall and walked into galleries and hung his own work. Banksy is one of the best-known artists of the 21st Century, yet, does anybody know who he really is? Directed by Finlay Bald.

programme.title: Beyonce: Queen B
programme.desc: One of the most recognizable figures in contemporary music. Get lost in the ultimate story of modern day superstardom as we take you through the incredible journey of Beyoncé. Directed by Billy Simpson.

We look back at the life and rise of the one who was once named the funniest man in America. Directed by Roxane Schlumberger

programme.title: David Bowie: Stardust
programme.desc: This documentary tells the story of how Bowie became one of the most iconic creations in the history of pop music. From his music, the fashion and the theatrical stage presents which turned Bowie into the biggest craze since the Beatles. Directed by Elena Carmen and Billy Simpson.

programme.title: Depp VS Heard: All On The Line
programme.desc: A trial that has divided fans and sent social and broadcast media into a frenzy. Two of the largest actors of modern-day (Johnny Depp and Amber Heard) go head to head in the court of law and public opinion. A gruelling 5 weeks. 50 million dollars on the line and a defamation case that will leave only one of them victorious. Everything is on the line in this battle of the century. This is… Depp vs Heard: All On The Line. Directed by Lucy Ciara McCutcheon.

programme.title: Depp VS Heard: The Verdict
programme.desc: April 2022. The world was watching the defamation trial of Johnny Depp vs Amber Heard, a murky, perplexing trial - at its centre one significant conflict. After deliberations the verdict was in... Directed by Lucy Ciara McCutcheon.

programme.title: Elton John: A Life In Song
programme.desc: Elton John's career has spanned decades, but his legacy is more than just his music. Reginald Dwight's early debut was in the band Bluesology - there he would meet lyricist Bernie Taupin whom he would go on to write over 30 albums with. After parting ways with the band and his birth name, the Rocketman was born. Directed by Finlay Bald.

programme.title: Elvis & Priscilla: Conditional Love
programme.desc: Elvis and Priscilla are one of the most famous celebrity couples of all time. But the story that lies beneath the glamorous facade is more toxic than what first meets the eye. Elvis has defined Pricilla's life. His comment that she was "young enough that he could train her any way he wanted,", in the end, came true. Though their relationship was bound by true love, what were the conditions that let it flourish? Directed by Finlay Bald.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When S and G rocket to outer space to mine a radioactive mineral from asteroids, Sonic and Tails stow away. Through a blunder by the robots, all are stranded in space, and Robotnik tries to blow all of them out of the stars. Sonic builds a rocket out of S and G's spare parts, and all return to Mobius.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik's attempt to turn Sonic into an old man with his newest device backfires, turning him and Tails, and later himself, into babies. Now stuck in a day-care, the infantile Sonic and Tails must try to keep Robotnik under control, while Scratch and Grounder attempt to get him back.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik plans to block out the sun and extinguish all life and nature on the planet Mobius. Then he creates a robot son and tries to train him in the ways of wickedness. But when Robotnik Jr. meets Sonic, he becomes a naturalist and teams up with Sonic to thwart Robotnik's evil scheme.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik invents an electron altering generator which makes Scratch and Grounder twice as fast as Sonic. When they lose it and Tails picks it up, Tails speeds through the Mobius countryside leaving disasters and accidents in his wake. Seeing this, Robotnik convinces the villagers that the little fox belongs in jail, and Tails is forced to flee. With Tails all alone, Scratch and Grounder attack, and Sonic makes a last minute rescue.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik captures a Kangaroo named MacHopper, and uses his brain-wipe-reprogramming-computer to transform him into a resourceful demolitions expert (Ala MacGiver). But Mac escapes before Robotnik installs the final Get Sonic program, and teams up with Sonic and Tails to BLAST Robotnik.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic joins up with a group of Dr. Robotnik's rejects who have been banished to the dump and helps them understand that their shortcomings were really their strengths.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When S and G rocket to outer space to mine a radioactive mineral from asteroids, Sonic and Tails stow away. Through a blunder by the robots, all are stranded in space, and Robotnik tries to blow all of them out of the stars. Sonic builds a rocket out of S and G's spare parts, and all return to Mobius.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When a Rebel Base is threatened by Robotnik, Sonic and Tails team up with Big Mike and Da Bears to run a booby-trapped gauntlet in their gigantic Road Warrior-like truck, breaking through every obstacle S and G put in their way until they save the rebels.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik pretends to retire, and lures Sonic and Tails into a phony vacation resort, laden with booby-traps set by Scratch and Grounder. But Sonic takes the bungee jumping, hang gliding, and skydiving in stride, and gives the bashes the bots.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik and a rival named Quark Rex try to cooperate in capturing Sonic. However, Sonic tricks them into becoming enemies, and they try to outdo each other.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Coconuts acquires a magic wand and magical gadgets from Wes Weasley (after agreeing to forward all payments to Robotnik), and attempts to master them. Meanwhile, Robotnik tries to change Sonic-themed mobium banknotes into Robotnik banknotes in the Mobius Mint.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: While on pursuit with Scratch and Grounder, Sonic and Tails hide in an underground mine which a miser mole think that they are trespassers.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic saves a female hedgehog from Scratch and Grounder which Sonic falls in love with, while Dr. Robotnik plans to flood a village by stealing the water from the Mobius reservoir.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic saves a female hedgehog from Scratch and Grounder which Sonic falls in love with, while Dr. Robotnik plans to flood a village by stealing the water from the Mobius reservoir.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic must save a family of sloths from Dr. Robotnik's slow-motion ray, but when he himself is slowed down by Scratch and Grounder, Tails and the sloth family must take action.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Desperate to get workers to build a Robotnik statue, Dr. Robotnik opens Casino Night Zone with his pal Smiley but when Sonic stops Scratch and Grounder, Robotnik traps Tails so Sonic has to make a choice to save his pal.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik imprisons a satirical cartoonist named Sketch Lampoon for making fun of him in his comic book, much to the anger of Sonic, his biggest fan. Sonic purposely allows his own capture as well, but does not expect to be placed in a maximum-security jail cell. With Robotnik angrily sends Sonic in the cell for interfering with his plans once again.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Scratch, Grounder and Coconuts set up a chili-dog trap which then resulted with Tails been captured by a mysterious person so Sonic has to find Tails and for Robotnik and co to capture Sonic.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.sub-title: Close Encounters of the Sonic Kind
programme.desc: While Scratch and Grounder try to catch Sonic using a Suction plate, two aliens, one being a prince, crash lands on Mobius. Sonic meets the prince when he finds out that the prince's baby brother would blow up Mobius which Sonic must save.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik's momma escapes from the home for mothers of villains and demands her birthday present! When she endangers Sonic and Tails, and they manage to have her taken back to the home, even Robotnik is glad to see her go.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Coconuts is exiled by Robotnik to a remote jungle, where he uses a giant baby ape to destroy villages. But Sonic exposes Coconuts as a robot, and the baby ape's real Dad takes Coconuts and the baby ape away for a spanking.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: A country and western singer released a song about Sonic which is making Dr. Robotnik mad and builds a music destroyer robot.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: An energetic salesman named Wes Weasley sells Robotnik numerous gadgets to help Scratch and Grounder capture Sonic. However, Robotnik later comes to regret it when Weaseley's gadgets keep backfiring.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic and Tails rescue Lucas, Robotnik's first prisoner, and attempt to reunite him with his girlfriend, Lucinda. However, Robotnik is also in love with Lucinda, and pursues Lucas.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: En route to stop a train of explosives from arriving at Robotnik's munition factory, Sonic and Tails must deal with a duo of bears named Big Griz and Big Mike after Scratch and Grounder tell them that Sonic and Tails are the enemies.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik takes Professor Von Schlemmer hostage and uses his growth machine to try and enlarge himself. However, the machine backfires, and enlarges Tails instead in nearby Wienerville. Sonic must keep the famished Tails from getting into more danger as Robotnik tricks the citizens into thinking that Sonic is the villain, while Robotnik is the hero planning to save the city.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When Sonic decides to find Tails a suitable foster home to ensure his safety, Robotnik finds out and creates a robot fox family, who pose as Tails' long-lost parents.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When overweight, elderly superhero Captain Rescue bungles in his attempts to help Sonic, he grows tired of his incompetence. Robotnik then uses Captain Rescue to successfully imprison Sonic in an impenetrable force field, and Tails and Captain Rescue must save him.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Scratch suffers a blow to the head and believes that he is his favorite television character, Edgar Eagle. Sonic uses this to his advantage in preventing another of Robotnik's schemes.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: There is a Sonic Appreciation Day happening where Sonic is the guest in a hotel. However, someone steals his power sneakers and now Sonic and Tails have to find the culprit.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Tails adopts a cute and fuzzy pet named Walter who turns out to be a black hole who sucks up everything in Mobius. Realizing that Walter is from another dimension our heroes have to return him and they soon find themselves spinning through interdimensional limbo.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When Robotnik opens up a resort to make the resident Mobians his slaves, Sonic enlists the help of some robots from an area of Mobius called Scrap Valley.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik creates a robot Sonic suit with the intent of ruining the hedgehog's reputation. He forces a lab rat named Laurence to pilot by threatening his parents.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Dr. Robotnik creates a genius chip so he would have enough brains to rule Mobius, however a computer hacker got hold of it which then the chip landed inside Grounder causing him to be smart.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic leaves Tails in charge of protecting a squirrel village food supply, when he zips off to stop a dam from breaking. Robotnik sends Scratch and Grounder after Tails, who defends himself the best he can with Home Alone booby traps for Scratch and Grounder. When Tails is finally caught, Sonic speeds back to save him.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik introduces the Ultra Freeze-O-Matic, announcing his plan to freeze every citizen on Mobius so that he can install Servitude Chips into the frozen citizens and make them unquestionably obedient. Sonic and Tails must foil the scheme.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When Robotnik invades Labyrinth, an underwater city, and kidnaps Princess Bubbles, a seahorse-dude named Surff seeks Sonic's help. It seems Surff and the Princess are in love, but the royal family deems Surff unworthy. Sonic, Tails and Surff must avoid the undersea traps and Mobius sea monsters while Sonic rescues the Princess and reunites her with Surff -- making it look like Surff did the whole thing.

programme.desc: “12hrs. & Running”: Dale turns a surprise 60th birthday party into a challenge to his guests to start 120 of the rarest motorcycles in the world.

programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.desc: An family farm in the mid-west contains houses, barns, outbuildings, trailers, grain silos and buses full of old stuff and perhaps the biggest stash of undiscovered old motorcycles in the country. The collection was put together by their unnamed father. Seller agrees to have Dale broker rare Excelsior for high-end client. Dale has the buyer, but will he outbid his own client for the exclusive find?

programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.desc: Matt is out for revenge. Last year Dale beat him badly at the Annual Vintage bike race in Barber, Alabama. But this year there is a whole new tale to tell. With just days until the race - Dale is secretly struggling to get the bike he beat Matt with last year up and working. Matt struggles just to locate a 100-year old bike. Matt's prayers are answered thanks to an old Catholic Priest he located who has possession of a bike. The priest might let Matt have the bike to race - but there are conditions. The toughest one: Don't tell Dale you have it. Can Matt afford to buy the bike and get it running in time for the race without Dale seeing it? Will Dale even get his broken bike started? And if they ever get to race, will Matt exact his revenge?

programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.desc: Built in the mid-60’s by eccentric engineer “Wild Bill” Gelbke, the Road Dog was, and still is, the largest motorcycle ever built. It utilized aircraft tubing, Corvette disc brakes, and a Chevy truck differential to keep it stable. The one-off creation disappeared when Gelbke did in 1978. Outflanked once when the bike was spotted and sold to a private collector in 1995, Dale has vowed to locate the machine and make Wheels Through Time its final resting place.

programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.desc: Big Time Motorcycle Auction

programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.desc: The RM Auction Company has worked with Dale before as a buyer, seller, historian, and caretaker at the prestigious Lee Hartung auction. But this event is no last minute rush to define one man’s treasures. This is a well calculated, time consuming, multi-media, and multi motorcycle and prized art deal.

programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.desc: Home Depot Senior Vice President, Gordon Erickson, is a huge fan of Wheels Through Time. He is also a huge supporter of the Wounded Warrior program. For years the hardware giant has been donating goods and services to help returning servicemen with their fix-it-up projects. Now they would like to go one step further and build a WWII military bike to raise awareness and funds. Only problem is where to get one? Enter Dale and an exhaustive, time sensitive, cross country search for a rare military machine.

programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.desc: Promoters of the prestigious Amelia Island Concours have called on Dale to develop a show and field bikes for an “Orphan Bike” show. They have defined orphan bike as extremely rare, that aren't a Harley nor Indian machines.

programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.sub-title: Time is Not On Their Side
programme.desc: For Dale and Matt sometimes the dotted line to treasure splits and heads in opposite directions. In this edition of What’s in the Barn, time is thrust to the forefront of this multi-state, long distance, north, south search. Timeless and priceless 110 year old bikes, antique cars, airplanes, and the infamous Egberts 1930 neon Harley-Davidson sign that coined the phrase “Ride a Winner” are high on this father and son’s list of “must haves”. The clock ticks, both literally and figuratively, on one rare time piece and two old-timer’s cars, bikes, and automobiles.

It utilized aircraft tubing, Corvette disc brakes, and a Chevy truck differential to keep it stable. The one-off creation disappeared when Gelbke did in 1978. Outflanked once when the bike was spotted and sold to a private collector in 1995, Dale has vowed to locate the machine and make Wheels Through Time its final resting place.

programme.title: Lost Classics

programme.title: Lost Classics

programme.title: Lost Classics

programme.title: Lost Classics

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Blues legend Joe Bonamassa is looking for a surprise gift for his parents. With his love of cars and guitars, Joe has to get Ray and Mr. H involved. From Mopar muscle to Mr. H’s man cave to a concert performance from Joe, this episode has a lot of Drive.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: In the early 1900s, race tracks built of wood sprang up across the country drawing crowds of 50,000 and more. Ray and Xtreme sports superstar Travis Pastrana break down the Battle on the Boards.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Ray finds an old T-Bucket that made a 133 mph pass at the Bonneville Salt Flats in 1951. The team brings the Woody Lee T back to life and attempts to match its original speed.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Ray finds a Gurney Eagle in a garage on Long Island. He wants to put the coveted machine back on the track at Indy to honor Dan Gurney. After intense restoration and scouring the globe for a Gurney-Westlake engine, the Eagle soars again.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Ray uncovers the infamous “Brawner Hawk” – from the Dean Van Lines team – that became the breakout car in the career of Mario Andretti. Ray enlists HOF mechanic Jim McGee to restore the vehicle and, along the way, discovers a replica with many of the car’s original parts. After an award winning stop at Concours Amelia Island, the car heads to the 100th running of Indy 500 where Mario Andretti himself gets behind the wheel.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Dale Earnhardt Jr. wants Ray to help restore an El Camino, except add on a Laguna front end. It’s not a typical restoration, but it’s certainly a NASCAR performance-worthy restoration. Ray and the team build the car and then, in a bit of gamesmanship, challenge Kyle Tucker, owner of Detroit Speed, to a series of races against his award winning Camaro. But as always, Ray has an ace up his sleeve in Al Unser, Jr. as his driver.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: In the late 60s, Camaros, Mustangs, and Corvettes roared to the forefront of the muscle car world. When Ray gets offered a spot in a vintage race featuring these cars, he’s propelled to dive into their history and afforded a chance to get behind the wheel at the Brickyard. But because it is a pro-am race, Ray pulls in a partner – none other than Bill Elliott, aka “Awesome Bill from Dawsonville.”

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Everyone has a car they fell in love with. Maybe it was the first? Maybe it was the hot rod the guy down the street owned? In Ray’s case, it was the ’58 Chevy he saw in the iconic coming of age car movie, American Graffiti. When Ray gets the chance to own the car after years and years of pursuit, he jumps on it. But restoring the car to its "movie state" proves to be a grueling task that goes way beyond a typical build. But when it's you first love, you can't let her down.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: The premiere episode features a dive into the influence cars had on culture of California. From road racing in the 1940’s to the inception of the iconic Woody wagon on the California beach scene, automobiles undoubtedly shaped the West Coast attitude. Ray talks to The Beach Boys frontman Mike Love and surfing icon Laird Hamilton for a glimpse into the cars that are so connected to surfing culture.

programme.title: Hands On Crafts for Kids
programme.desc: Today's show is all about perspective or how we see objects in space. Perspective is the technique of representing three dimensional objects on a two dimensional space -- like drawing a house on a flat piece of paper. It's all a point of view from which we categorize or measure -- like a tree that gets smaller and smaller as we walk away from it. Our first example is an optical treasure box with geometric patterns. Next, build your own kaleidoscope. Add to your art journal -- how perspective makes buildings and other city scenes more realistic. Finally, make a lightweight ball with streamers and watch it fly through the air and learn about perspective.

programme.title: The Abominable Snowbeast
programme.desc: Brainy and his friends organize a journey to Ice Mountain to pick the rare snow flower for Papa Smurf. They meet a terrifying snow beast that befriends them, due to Smurfette's kindness, and helps them find the tiny flower.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Smurfette has found a new friend, Laura, a six-year-old child whose parents live near the forest. Together, the two girls wander in the forest. But an old witch who lives in the forest catches them.

programme.title: Gormandizing Greedy
programme.desc: Greedy overdoes it. He's getting heavier and heavier until his weight puts him in jeopardy. The evil Gargamel is going to catch him... Can Greedy be saved by Papa Smurf?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: An evil imp gives Smurfette dancing shoes and then tricks her into promising to marry him. All her little friends rush to her rescue and Papa Smurf magically puts the dancing shoes on the imp. He is forced to dance off into the night.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Sir Hefty discovers a wayward knight to help him defeat a dragon whose fire is threatening to destroy the forest. Alas, the knight proves to be a coward, leaving Hefty to prove just how brave he is when he sends the dragon away from Smurf Village.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Clumsy and Smurfette are captured by the wicked Bombast, who plans to exhibit them in his sideshow. Papa Smurf hurries to their rescue and using the bungling Gargamel for interference is able to rescue his Smurfs.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Because they feel unappreciated, Poet and Painter leave Smurf Village and head for Storm Island, totally unaware that Gargamel is planning to trap them. Papa Smurf and his faithful volunteers rescue their friends.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.sub-title: The Good, The Bad And The Smurfy
programme.desc: King Argon is a burly, boorish brute, but his wizard Mordain is worse still. He plans to use several Smurfs he has captured to steal all of the King's gold...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.sub-title: The Smurf Who Couldn't Say No
programme.desc: Being asked to go to the Marsh to bring back the rare Foxfire is a great honor for a Smurf. But Scaredy Smurf is reluctant to confront the Marsh Monster so he sends the Smurf who cannot say no.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Determined to fly over Smurf village to catch a Smurf to take to the Wizard's Convention, Gargamel invokes his Book of Spells to help him. A series of funny flying machine mishaps occur and Gargamel is once more the laughing stock of the Wizard's Convention.

programme.title: The First Telesmurf
programme.desc: Papa Smurf pours a magic potion over the new Smurf-melon patch, which instantly grows and grows all over the village and forest. The Smurfs use the blossoms as a telephone, but before Gargamel can trace their voices, the flowers turn into melons and telesmurf is no more.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: In his search for something new, Vanity dons a Gargamel-made magic hat that transforms his face into a mess. Through trickery, Papa Smurf gets the antidote from the wicked wizard and once more, Vanity is beautiful.

programme.title: No Time For Smurfs
programme.desc: Handy, Brainy, Clumsy, and Smurfette discover the hourglass of time in a cave and due to their bungling, time spins erratically out of control for all of the Smurfs.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Due to a wild experiment Clumsy is able to store endless knowledge into his memory. Gargamel captures him, trying to unlock Papa Smurf's invisibility formula, but at the last minute, Clumsy tricks him with the wrong ingredients.

programme.title: Good Neighbour Smurf
programme.desc: When Brainy's house burns down, he moves in with his fellow Smurfs; and one by one they kick him out because of his meddling.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Papa Smurf gives Weakling a special cream to wear that will restore his strength. Shortly after, he is awarded for his daring deeds of strength and his confidence really soars when he realizes the cream is smurfberry jam.

programme.title: Harmony Steals The Show
programme.desc: Harmony unwittingly signs a contract with Ghost Writer for a symphony that imprisons him in a ghostly nightclub for life! Papa Smurf demands a jury trial with ghostly jurors and a judge that finds Harmony innocent and Ghost Writer guilty of plagiarism.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Hogatha the witch promises Gargamel a magical whistle if he will introduce her to the warlock of her dreams. But they are both deceived by each other's trickery: Gargamel dresses up as the warlock, and Hogatha's magical whistle is only a birdcall.

programme.title: A Bell For Azrael
programme.desc: Gargamel puts a spell on a bell attached to Azrael's tail that will lead the cat to the Smurfs. Papa Smurf outwits him with a counter-spell that leads the wizard to Big Mouth instead of the tasty Smurfs.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Hefty dresses like Smurfette to lure an enamored gnome, Piltkin, away from the Smurf Village. They burrow underground and meet a female gnome who falls in love with Piltkin who then casts Smurfette aside for his new heartthrob.

programme.title: The Magic Earrings
programme.desc: Hogatha manages to obtain the magic golden earrings of Sonoria that will enable her to hear Smurfy voices from afar. Following Lazy's snores, she almost reaches the Smurf Village until Harmony's horn-blasts blow in her earrings and she flies home in a rage.

programme.title: Gargamel's Last Will
programme.desc: Scruple, apprentice to the evil wizard Gargamel, is not above playing a trick or two on his master. When he learns that Puppy, the dog that belongs to the Smurfs, bit Gargamel, Scruple tells the wizard that by midnight, he'll have changed into a dog....

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: When his bear runs away from his fairground show, the gruff, uncouth Malakoff thinks he's out of business. But he's able to catch a much better show: the Smurflings. Can Brainy and Wild Smurf find a way to bring back the runaway bear?

programme.title: Smurfing The Unicorns
programme.desc: When Puppy, the Smurfs' well-loved dog, drinks tainted water and becomes very sick, Papa Smurf says there is only one chance to save him – but what is needed is the touch of a unicorn's horn. Can the Smurfs find it?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Nobody Smurf is the Smurf that everybody always forgets. He'd like to develop a personality, get some sort of recognition from his peers, but he fails miserably. Must he remain forever the one that is overlooked? Or will he find his true personality?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: In another Smurf theatrical super-production based – very loosely – on Alexandre Dumas' characters, a masterpiece of the stage is created, with a few lines from Romeo and Juliet thrown in.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs come to the rescue of two children and their grandfather when a mysterious stranger appears and causes their sleigh to crash. Knocking on Gargamel's door for help puts them and the Smurfs in danger…

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Handy has built a very complex Smurf machine that does everything. It proves dangerous when it nearly destroys the village, but comes in useful when, with the help of the other Smurfs, it saves the young prince Gerard's kingdom from the queen aunt Imperia's dastardly intentions.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs discover a fountain of youth that is guarded by a wicked troll, who steals Papa Smurf's magic book. They convince Gargamel to help them and the greedy villain runs to get the water, but manages to fall in with the troll. As the two chase each other all over the countryside, the Smurfs are able to retrieve Papa Smurf's book.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Simon is lost in the forest and in search of his parents. Simon is the son of a couple of giants. The Smurfs try to bring him home, but then Gargamel interrupts the party.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Once in a blue moon, as the legend goes, a baby Smurf is delivered to the Smurfs and everyone in the village becomes attached to the new arrival. But a mistake has been made and the stork returns to take the baby back. Grouchy and Smurfette have become so attached to the baby that the baby is returned.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Growing, harvesting and preparing food takes up much of the Smurfs' time. Handy invents a machine that farms and processes food. But this wonderful invention has its drawbacks...

programme.title: S-Shivering S-Smurfs
programme.desc: Winter has come all of a sudden. The Smurfs are almost all victims of smurfmonia. Can Tracker Smurf find the healing smurfroot without falling into the evil Gargamel's traps?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: This is the dramatic, moving story of the friendship between Smurfette and her pet mouse. A sad event reduces Smurfette to tears... Can the Smurfs comfort the despairing Smurfette?

programme.title: It Came From Outer Smurf
programme.desc: Dreamy wants to encounter beings from outer space so much that no one believes him when he talks of having met one. Yet the arrival of this extraterrestrial is going to wreak havoc in the Smurf Village...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Handy Smurf has saved Clumsy from a horrible fate. Clumsy swears eternal devotion to his savior and does his best to repay his debt… With awkward results. A clever scheme is needed to stop Clumsy's well-meant catastrophes...

programme.title: Revenge Of The Smurfs
programme.desc: A war is raging in the Middle Ages. Knights in armor in hot pursuit inadvertently destroy the Smurfs Village so a small band of Smurfs decide to avenge this wrongdoing. Won't Papa Smurf think this is too human-like a reaction?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Gargamel has found a new diabolical scheme to get rid of the Smurfs: a glittering powder that is going to reduce them to helpless laughter...

programme.title: The A-Maze-Ing Smurfs
programme.desc: Jokey Smurf is dying to meet Melchior the Magnificent, creator of the famous Vanishing Box trick. Can Gargamel catch the Smurfs in Melchior's Amazing Maze?

programme.title: Smurf Van Winkle
programme.desc: Lazy Smurf is getting too lazy. The other Smurfs decide to play a trick on him: when he wakes up, he is surrounded by wrinkled, elderly Smurfs who tell him he has been sleeping for several centuries...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Scaredy Smurf runs into the Village screaming about the sky being about to smurf down. And just at the same moment, Papa Smurf is beset by uncontrollable fits of sneezing...

programme.title: Turncoat Smurf
programme.desc: Would you believe Brainy Smurf is the one who led the evil Gargamel to the Village of the Smurf? Of course he did not. But the others suspect him...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: What a strange stone Clumsy has unearthed! In it, he can see events that are going to happen... Yet knowing part of the future sometimes brings bad luck!

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Brainy Smurf has decided to dedicate himself to the wellbeing of his fellow Smurfs. He is going to cure them of all ills… With a little help from the evil Gargamel!

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs love truffles but truffles belong to the Trolls and the Trolls live under Truffle Troll Mountain, where in the shadows of the lake lurks the Thing with No Name...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: When the flower fairy Nymph arrives at the Smurf Village, all the Smurfs fall for her charm and wit. And soon they learn that she is to be some sort of Mama Smurf to them...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Papa Smurf recalls Dreamy's exciting voyage on the high seas and his gripping adventures with sea turtles, whales, desert islands... and pirates!

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Gargamel's theft of the Fairies' gold almost brings a state of war between the Fairies and the Smurfs.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs' theatrical production of 'Robin Smurf' comes to life as the legendary hero is portrayed by a really good actor...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: A beautiful princess is turned into a hag and needs the whiskers of a cat and the tear of a Smurf for her magic potion. Azrael, Grouchy and Jokey unwittingly cooperate and as the magical transformation takes place, the princess frees them and they happily hurry home.

programme.title: How To Smurf A Rainbow
programme.desc: Mother Nature is too busy to conjure a rainbow for the Smurfs' festival, so Papa Smurf borrows her cookbook and mixes up the recipe himself. As there is no yellow available, they use the leprechaun's gold to produce a beautiful rainbow before Gargamel can steal it.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Disaster strikes when Brainy and Baby mix up Papa Smurf's formulas, leaving them powerless before an army of hungry locusts unleashed on the forest by Gargamel.

programme.title: Lumbering Smurfs
programme.desc: Greedy tree cutters plan to chop down King Gerard's forest while he is away on vacation. Papa Smurf disguises the Smurfs as ghosts to scare the lumberjacks who willingly surrender to the returning King and his array.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.sub-title: A Hovel Is Not A Home
programme.desc: In his search for a grander hovel, Gargamel looks in the Great Book of Spells to conjure up a new home. But all of his spells backfire and that convinces him that there's no place like home!

programme.title: Speak For Yourself, Farmer Smurf
programme.desc: Farmer hides his love for Smurfette by assuming a disguise and sending her poems. When they finally meet, they are captured by Bigmouth and in their struggle to get free, they discover their mutual friendship.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Gargamel infects Hefty's heart with hate and then uses the little Smurf as a decoy for the others. Fortunately, Hefty's love overcomes his hate and he helps his little friends escape from Gargamel's clutches.

programme.title: To Smurf A Thief
programme.desc: The Smurfs and Homnibus befriend an unfortunate boy who is forced to steal for his master. Soon, the evil thief is turned over to the magistrate and the boy is happy to live with Homnibus.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Little Sickly turns into a hero when he forgets his ailments and saves the rest of the Smurfs from the deadly forget-me flowers.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs are so busy testing their individual willpower that they fail to notice Gargamel has captured Harmony. Only when Papa Smurf offers Gargamel a trick box to test his willpower does Harmony escape.

programme.title: Clumsy Luck
programme.desc: The Smurfs learn about superstition when Clumsy breaks Vanity's mirror prior to a meteor shower. When a meteor falls on Clumsy's house, everyone attributes it to bad luck, but realize the foolishness of this philosophy when they see Clumsy was not in the house at the time.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The good fairy, Guinilda gives Greedy a magic porridge pot that Brainy causes to overflow into the village and forest. The good-hearted fairy hurries to the rescue and then asks for the pot back to give to an orphanage of hungry children.

programme.title: Vanity's Closest Friend
programme.desc: To Vanity Smurf there is no spectacle more enlightening, no pursuit more rewarding than looking at himself. When he meets an admiring imp, he's sure he's found his best friend ever. But things are not always that simple, and friends can make trouble.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Everyday the same routine, the same chores, the same life. Smurfette is bored with it all. Wouldn't a long sailing trip on the high seas be a lot more fun? It just so happens that Dreamy Smurf is planning a cruise. Won't that be paradise?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Clockwork becomes too hot handle when he's hit by lightning. Papa has to hurry to cool him off before he burns himself out. But Clockwork nearly uses his last volt of power saving the Smurfs from Gargamel.

programme.title: Smoogle Sings The Blues
programme.desc: Chlorhydris plots to change spring into the unhappiest time of year. She goes after the Bluebird of Happiness, and transforms him into a cawing raven. Whoever hears the Song of the Raven of Unhappiness will be unhappy. It's up to Grouchy to save spring.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The evil Maestro's magical paints have the power to transport his models onto canvas – forever! Papa Smurf directs Painter to switch his paints and before long, Maestro is enshrined in a picture next to his dream girl, Smurfette.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Hogatha disguises herself as the Golden Smurf Award to catch the Smurfs in order to use them as the main ingredient in her beauty cream. programme.title: The Smurfs

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs learn that the mind is more powerful than matter when they are fooled by a quack's outrageously expensive miracle tonic. But Papa Smurf cures the Smurfs of their temporary naiveté and the charlatan of his villainy.

programme.desc: While out on a mischief-making mission to destroy the Smurfs' Happy Halloween party, Gargamel and Hogatha catch Lazy who has been accidentally turned red by Mother Nature. programme.desc: Iqbal is an inspiring sports drama about a young boy (played by Shreyas Talpade) who is deaf and mute but dreams of playing cricket for the Indian national team. With the help of a reclusive former cricketer (Naseeruddin Shah), he trains rigorously, battling societal prejudices, family pressure, and systemic challenges. Directed by Nagesh Kukunoor, the film is a heartfelt celebration of determination, dreams, and triumph against adversity. It’s widely appreciated for its emotional depth and uplifting narrative.

programme.title: NH 10
programme.desc: NH10 is an intense survival thriller starring Anushka Sharma as Meera, a woman who embarks on a road trip with her husband, only to witness an honor killing. When they intervene, they find themselves hunted by the perpetrators in a lawless rural region. The film explores themes of gender violence, societal injustice, and the terrifying vulnerability of urban citizens in rural anarchy. Directed by Navdeep Singh, NH10 delivers gripping tension, gritty realism, and a powerful female lead performance.
